WITH equipment_avgs AS (
  SELECT 
    equipref,
    AVG(humepct) as equip_avg_humidity
  FROM scanenvironment
  WHERE humepct IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY equipref
),
all_equip_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(equip_avg_humidity) as overall_avg_humidity
  FROM equipment_avgs
),
kept_equipment AS (
  SELECT 
    ea.equipref,
    ea.equip_avg_humidity
  FROM equipment_avgs ea
  CROSS JOIN all_equip_avg aea
  WHERE ea.equip_avg_humidity > aea.overall_avg_humidity
),
kept_equip_stats AS (
  SELECT AVG(equip_avg_humidity) as kept_equip_mean_humidity
  FROM kept_equipment
),
with_all_averages AS (
  SELECT 
    ke.equipref,
    ke.equip_avg_humidity,
    aea.overall_avg_humidity,
    kes.kept_equip_mean_humidity,
    ke.equip_avg_humidity - aea.overall_avg_humidity as exceeds_overall_avg,
    ke.equip_avg_humidity - kes.kept_equip_mean_humidity as diff_from_kept_mean
  FROM kept_equipment ke
  CROSS JOIN all_equip_avg aea
  CROSS JOIN kept_equip_stats kes
  WHERE aea.overall_avg_humidity IS NOT NULL 
    AND kes.kept_equip_mean_humidity IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT 
  equipref,
  equip_avg_humidity,
  exceeds_overall_avg,
  diff_from_kept_mean
FROM with_all_averages
ORDER BY diff_from_kept_mean DESC
LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: The phrase "Return nothing if either reference average is missing" is interpreted as: if overall_avg_humidity or kept_equip_mean_humidity evaluates to NULL, return an empty result set (zero rows).
